  More precisely: 5,207,000,000 / 71,388 = 72,933.6... Let me compute carefully: 71,388 × 72,900 = 5,203,985,200; remainder 3,014,800; 3,014,800 / 71,388 = 42.24. So 72,942.24 L/yr. Divided by 365 = 199.8422 L/day.
- Ashgrove: 4,390 × 1,000,000 = 4,390,000,000 L per year. 4,390,000,000 / 58,760: 58,760 × 74,700 = 4,389,372,000; remainder 628,000; 628,000 / 58,760 = 10.69. So 74,710.69 L/yr. Divided by 365 = 204.6875 L/day.

Comparison: Ashgrove's households used more per resident per day. Difference: 204.6875 − 199.8422 = 4.8453 L/resident/day.

Checking the difference more precisely: Ashgrove 74,710.69/365 = 204.6876; Tarnvale 72,942.24/365 = 199.8422. Difference ≈ 4.8454. Rounding to 3 decimals, I'll state 4.845 based on the refined values (Ashgrove 204.6876, Tarnvale 199.8422, difference 4.8454 → 4.845).

Answer: Ashgrove used more, by about 4.845 litres per resident per day.

ANSWER: Ashgrove | 4.845
